script_text: Taurus, this week the cosmos is rewriting your love story — and your bank account feels it too. Your ruling planet Venus strikes a powerful trine with Jupiter in your 9th House, sparking fresh confidence. Tuesday is your career power day as Mercury sextiles your Midheaven in the 10th House, so pitch bold ideas now. The mid-week turning point arrives Thursday, June 5th, when Venus enters your 11th House, shifting your energy toward friendships and community support. By Saturday, the Moon in Cancer forms a delicate square with your Sun, so guard your peace and watch for emotional tension at home, Taurus. Your best day is Friday, when Venus connects with Mars and amplifies your 7th House of partnerships — perfect for date night sparks or sealing a business deal. Your worst day is Sunday, as the Moon's square to your first house creates tension and second-guessing. This week, Earth's child, lean on your Taurus steadiness and trust the slow burn. Follow for daily updates.
